general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45 contact hours (60 sessions) + 1.5 hours final exam + 103.5 hours self-study
general_information.Description: "-Objective: The course is designed to provide students with theoretical knowledge and practical scenarios related to public service interpreting in different settings including health care, media, police, military services, business, job training programs.. -Description: The course is composed of theoretical lectures familiarizing students with different interpreting settings of public services. Based on authentic audio and video language materials related to health care, media, police, military services... scenarios are created for learners to take turn to accomplish their roles as interpreters. -Teaching method: Constructive Teaching Method is highly recommended. During the course, lectures may take place in different forms including traditional classroom, conference-styled classrooms, or outdoor activities.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes - Read the textbook in advance

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Acquire theoretical knowledge of general issues in public service interpreting
Understand the ambiguity of public service interpreters. Identify the positions of public service interpreters.
Determine the mediated interactions role of interpreter in public service interpreting
Understand and perform the roles of interepreter in the social context and cultural assumptions.
Acqurire skills & knowledge to apply in different public service interpreting settings
Acquire theoretical knowledge of general issues in different public service settings like health care, business, education, community events, court, military services, workshops...,

Be able to perfom the role of interpeter in different public service settings with specific scenarios related to health care, business, education, community events, court, military services, workshops...,
Be a responsible and ethical interpreter or translator

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: From unit 6- unit 8 CLO6 CLO7 CLO8
assessments.Grading Guide: Students join a field trip to an international hospital or a company. Work in groups to implement the tasks of interpreters in real time situations.
Work in groups to conduct a study on the reality of Public Service Interpreting in VN. Take turns to present and interpret.
Each group is assigned to host a simulation workshop. Topic: Selective (science, business, IT...) in Vietnamese or English. Groups take turn to organize and interpreted at the workshops.
Students watch a 4- 5 minute video clip twice. Then interpreted. Video clip contents: Speeches, reports, …. in conferences, workshops settings.
Student pick up the question, then look at the question and interpret (a 200-220 word conversation conducted public service settings like in hospital, in court, in business meeting. ..)

schedule.Topic: 6.4 Public Service Interpreting practice in health care Scenario: A Vietnamese patient, Mr. Nguyễn, is in Singapore for specialized treatment of a rare blood disorder. Dr. Tan and her medical team at Singapore General Hospital are in charge of his care. Mr. Nguyễn speaks very little English, and the doctors don't speak Vietnamese, so an interpreter is present.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Work in groups to implement the tasks given the in scenario.

schedule.Topic: 6.4 Public Service Interpreting practice in health care Scenario: A foreign patient, Mrs.Linda, has been hospitalized in Vietnam due to a severe viral infection causing respiratory distress. Dr. Tuan and his team are handling her case. The patient does not speak Vietnamese, so an interpreter is essential to communicate important information, including the need for a medical procedure.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Work in groups to implement the tasks given the in scenario.

schedule.Topic: 6.4 Public Service Interpreting practice in health care Scenario: A Vietnamese patient, Mr. Phạm, arrives at an international hospital with severe chest pain and shortness of breath. Dr. Patel and her cardiac team suspect a major heart issue that requires emergency surgery. Mr. Phạm speaks little English, and an interpreter is needed to explain the situation, the urgency, and the necessary surgery.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Work in groups to implement the tasks given the in scenario.

schedule.Topic: 6.5 Public Service Interpeting practice in health care
schedule.Student's Tasks: Watch the youtube, then interprete it into Vietnamese.

schedule.Topic: 7.5 Public Service Interpreting practice in Legal Setting Scenario: At the U.S. Embassy interview room, a woman from Vietnam is applying for a U.S. visa and requires an interpreter to assist her in answering questions. The visa officer speaks only English, and the interpreter is facilitating communication between the officer and the woman.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Work in groups to implement the tasks given the in scenario.

schedule.Topic: 7.5 Public Service Interpreting in Legal Setting Scenario: At a legal agency office in Hanoi, Vietnam, An American, who speaks no Vietnamese, is seeking advice on how to apply for a work permit in Vietnam. A legal officer is explaining the process, while an interpreter is translating between English and Vietnamese to facilitate the discussion.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Work in groups to implement the tasks given the in scenario.

schedule.Topic: 7.5 Public Service Interpreting in Legal Setting Scenario: At a courtroom in Vietnam, a divorce case is being heard between a Vietnamese wife and her foreign (non-Vietnamese speaking) husband. The court has appointed an interpreter to ensure the husband can understand the proceedings. The judge is presiding over the case, and the interpreter is translating between Vietnamese and English.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Work in groups to implement the tasks given the in scenario.

schedule.Topic: 8.5 Practice Public Service Interpreting in business settings Scenario: Interpreting at a Business Meeting to Discuss Marketing a New Model of Milk Products. At a conference room in a large office building in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, around the table sits a team of Vietnamese marketing executives and sales managers, alongside their American manager, Mr. John, who does not speak Vietnamese. An interpreter, Ms. Linh, is seated beside him, ready to translate between the two parties. On the table, there are samples of the new model of milk products, including flavored milk, lactose-free milk, and protein-enriched milk. The team is gathered to discuss strategies for launching these products in the Vietnamese market.
schedule.Student's Tasks: Work in groups to implement the tasks given the in scenario.
